newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Energy Equity reports Singa well discovery.
newsitem.headline: Energy Equity reports Singa well discovery.

text.p: Energy Equity Corp Ltd said on Monday production testing at its Singa-1 exploration well has resulted in significant gas flows and confirmed a major discovery.
Energy Equity said the well in South Sumatra had tested the lower third, the poorest reservoir quality, of the primary objective of the Batu Raja formation.

A multi-rate test included flow rates of 20.3 million cubic feet per day over 12-1/4 hours through a 40/64 inch choke, and an 8.2 million cubic feet per day over three hours through a 16/64 inch choke.
Energy Equity said additional testing in the more porous middle and upper sections of the Batu Raja formation would follow.
A three dimensional seismic programme would be conducted, likely in the fourth quarter 1997, followed by a two or three well delineation drilling programme.
"Plans are being made for an early production scheme to produce Singa-1 into the existing local markets within the next 12-18 months," Energy Equity said in a statement.
Energy Equity is the operator of the production sharing contract and has a 20 percent interest.
Amerada Hess Corp has a 50 percent stake, Coparex International SA 15 percent and Novus Petroleum Ltd 15 percent.
Energy Equity shares were eight cents firmer at 10.25 a.m. (0025 GMT) at A$1.63, while Novus was up three cents at A$4.50.
